verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is API-first: it exposes REST endpoints (incorporation, notarization, translation, tax-registration, trade-registration) that can be called headlessly, supports polling of status, webhooks for async events, and HMAC-signed callbacks — all core building blocks for CI/automation pipelines without a UI. Missing for 10: explicit CLI/SDK tooling, documented rate limits or idempotency guarantees for automated retries, and independent/hands-on confirmation of real CI usage.
